design.axis_exclusion: exact pair-axis stations omitted; covered by symbolic mean-gap and divided-difference charts

adjudication.r_scaling: The sampled intensity is proportional to r, with intensity/r stable across four rungs.
adjudication.pin_collision: At rho down to 0.02, r^3 rho^2 times the gradient density and the triple moment divided by r^6 rho^2 remain finite, confirming the exact collision cancellation.
adjudication.axis: Near-axis samples are suppressed; the exact axis chart is handled analytically.
